title.en: An Act Amending Section Twenty-One Hundred Eighty-Four of the Revised Administrative Code, as Amended By Republic Act Numbered Forty-Three Hundred and Fifty-Eight, By Increasing the Maximum Limit of Salaries of Municipal Officers.

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6414_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: All Acts or parts thereof inconsistent with any of the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 4, 1971.
